Japanese pupils at age 13 have better scores of average attainment than their counterparts in England.
Holland and the UK have reclaimed marshes and flood plains from the sea.
The UK developed and launched six satellites from 1962 to 1979 in collaboration with NASA.
The UK did not play a role in the 'Space Race' between the world's two military superpowers.

The European Union functions because the leaders of the big continental countries want it to.
